newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power leaves Thurs prices unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power leaves Thurs prices unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left its price offers for next-day firm and non-firm sales unchanged from Tuesday's preschedulings, the federal power marketing agency said Wednesday.
Sales volumes for firm power between 1300 and 2100 PDT on Thursday also continued to be capped at 200 megawatts.
Electricity between those hours was offered at $20.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) ($19.00 non-firm).
Power for hours 0700-1200 and 2200-2300 PDT was offered at $18.00 ($17.00 non-firm), and at $13.00 for both firm and non-firm power during hours 0100-0600 and the hour ending 2400.
